secrets.name: WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY
secrets.description: WooCommerce REST API v3 consumer key (from WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API). Needed for login, checkout, and account features.

secrets.name: WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET
secrets.description: WooCommerce REST API v3 consumer secret (paired with the consumer key). Needed for login, checkout, and account features.

secrets.name: FLUTTERWAVE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Flutterwave payment gateway secret key (from Flutterwave dashboard → Settings → API). Needed for checkout payments when PAYMENT_PROVIDER=flutterwave.

secrets.name: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack payment gateway secret key (from Paystack dashboard → Settings → API Keys → Secret Key). Needed for checkout payments when PAYMENT_PROVIDER=paystack.

secrets.name: BREVO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Brevo (Sendinblue) API key for transactional email — OTP verification and password reset emails. From Brevo dashboard → SMTP & API → API Keys.

secrets.name: TERMINAL_API_KEY
secrets.description: Terminal Africa (TShip) API key for live delivery rate quotes. From Terminal Africa dashboard → Settings → API. Only needed when SHIPPING_PROVIDER=tship.

secrets.name: AUTH_GOOGLE_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID for Google sign-in (Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials). Only needed when NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_LOGIN_ENABLED=true.

secrets.name: AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret (paired with AUTH_GOOGLE_ID). Only needed when NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_LOGIN_ENABLED=true.
